description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT across three distinct topics and three language models. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into "Movies", "Songs", and "Basketball", appearing in that order from left to right without an explicit axis label or overall sorting arrangement. The vertical axis is labeled "Ratio (%)" and employs a linear scale with a visible value range from 50 to 90, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 10, accompanied by corresponding horizontal grid lines. The data is visually arranged into clustered groups of three bars per category on the horizontal axis. A legend located at the top center of the chart indicates that the blue bars represent Llama3, the red bars represent Qwen2, and the yellow bars represent ChatGPT. In the "Movies" category, Llama3 reaches approximately 90%, Qwen2 has the tallest bar in the entire chart at roughly 90.5%, and ChatGPT is at about 73%. Within "Songs", Llama3 shows an approximate value of 84%, Qwen2 is at 90%, and ChatGPT measures near 63%. Finally, in the "Basketball" category, Llama3 is around 67%, Qwen2 represents the shortest bar in the chart at approximately 58%, and ChatGPT sits at roughly 61.5%. There is no strict ascending, descending, or alphabetical sorting applied to the data overall, and none of the individual bars feature additional visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, outlining, or explicit numeric annotations.
